function.arguments: {"finding": "The data shows that female patients have a higher overall response rate (76.0%) than male patients (69.7%). The key confounder is that males are more likely to be assigned to the treatment arm, especially in the severe severity group, where the treatment may be more effective. Without adjusting for severity, the observed sex difference in response is misleading.", "implication": "The raw comparison of female vs. male response rates is invalid due to confounding by severity. function.name: note_finding
